source.title: Application Period Closed for Continental Championships 2022 (October 2020)
source.content:
Application submissions are now closed for African, South American, and Oceanian Continental Championships 2022. We are pleased to announce that we have received the following candidacies to host these Championships:

**WCA African Championship:**
Cairo, Egypt
Cape Town, South Africa

**WCA South American Championship:**
Brasília, Brazil 

The Board received no applications for Oceania.

The candidacy documents will be made public after the decisions are finalized. The final list of the competition locations will be announced by the end of October. Thank you to all who submitted their offers!

translation.title: 2022 年洲际锦标赛申办截止（2020 年 10 月）
translation.content:
2022 年非洲、南美洲和大洋洲锦标赛的申办现已截止。我们很高兴地公布收到的申办城市：

**WCA 非洲锦标赛：**

* 埃及开罗
* 南非开普敦

**WCA 南美洲锦标赛：**

* 巴西巴西利亚

董事会未收到大洋洲锦标赛的申办申请。

申办材料将在决定作出后公开，最终举办地点将在 10 月底前公布。感谢所有提交方案的团队！
